subproblem.title: Mass and rotational-flux limits in the small boxes at the edge point
subproblem.statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and C ∈ 𝒟_2(ℝ^P) be minimizing in ℝ^P (IsMinimizingIn C univ), with ∂C = 0 and a cone (IsConeCurrent C). Let Q be a 2-dimensional linear subspace of ℝ^P, a, e ∈ Q with |a| = |e| = 1 and ⟨a, e⟩ = 0, δ > 0 and k ∈ ℕ with k ≥ 1. Assume a ∈ spt C and that for all t > 0 and φ ∈ (0, δ) the point y := t(cos φ·a + sin φ·e) satisfies HasMassDensity C y k and spt C ∩ B_r(y) ⊆ Q for some r > 0. Let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity representation of C, μ := R.measure, m ∈ ℕ with HasMassDensity C a m, and 0 < s ≤ 1/4 such that the localization property Loc(s) holds: for every s' ∈ (0, s] and every x ∈ spt C with ⟨x, a⟩ > 0, ||x| − 1| < s', |f(x)| < s' and |x − πx| ≤ 2s|x| one has |x − πx| < (s'/4)|x| and |x − a| < 3s' (π := Q.starProjection, f(x) := arctan(⟨x, e⟩/⟨x, a⟩)). For s' > 0 let Z(s, s') := {x : ⟨x, a⟩ > 0, ||x| − 1| < s', |f(x)| < s', |x − πx| < s|x|} and G(x) := |p_{T_x}(Ax)|²/|πx|² with Ax := ⟨x, a⟩e − ⟨x, e⟩a and T_x := approxTangentPlane 2 M x. Then, as s' → 0⁺, μ(Z(s, s'))/s'² → 4m and (∫_{Z(s, s')} G dμ)/s'² → 4m in [0, ∞] (μ(·)/ofReal(s'²) and (∫⁻ ofReal G dμ)/ofReal(s'²)).
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e : Euclid P) (δ : ℝ) (k : ℕ), IsMinimizingIn C univ → BoundaryVanishes C → IsConeCurrent C → Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → a ∈ Q → e ∈ Q → ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ a e = 0 → 0 < δ → 1 ≤ k → a ∈ C.support → (∀ t φ : ℝ, 0 < t → 0 < φ → φ < δ → HasMassDensity C (t • (Real.cos φ • a + Real.sin φ • e)) k ∧ ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ C.support ∩ ball (t • (Real.cos φ • a + Real.sin φ • e)) r ⊆ (Q : Set (Euclid P))) → ∀ (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (m : ℕ) (s : ℝ), R.Represents C → HasMassDensity C a m → 0 < s → s ≤ 1 / 4 → (∀ s' : ℝ, 0 < s' → s' ≤ s → ∀ x ∈ C.support, 0 < inner ℝ x a → |‖x‖ - 1| < s' → |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| < s' → ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ ≤ 2 * s * ‖x‖ → ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ < s' / 4 * ‖x‖ ∧ dist x a < 3 * s') → Tendsto (fun s' : ℝ => R.measure {x : Euclid P | 0 < inner ℝ x a ∧ |‖x‖ - 1| < s' ∧ |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| < s' ∧ ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ < s * ‖x‖} / ENNReal.ofReal (s' ^ 2)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (4 * (m : ℝ≥0∞))) ∧ Tendsto (fun s' : ℝ => (∫⁻ x in {x : Euclid P | 0 < inner ℝ x a ∧ |‖x‖ - 1| < s' ∧ |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| < s' ∧ ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ < s * ‖x‖}, ENNReal.ofReal (‖(approxTangentPlane 2 R.carrier x).starProjection (inner ℝ x a • e - inner ℝ x e • a)‖ ^ 2 / ‖Q.starProjection x‖ ^ 2) ∂R.measure) / ENNReal.ofReal (s' ^ 2)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (4 * (m : ℝ≥0∞)))
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: parent step 10(a)–(c) (tilt and mass in the boxes Z_s(s')). Conventions: H² := μHE[2]; μ = θ·H²⌞M, θ ≥ 1 on M, so H²(M ∩ S) ≤ μ(S) for Borel S and μ ≪ H²⌞M; q(x) := x − πx; Ax := ⟨x,a⟩e − ⟨x,e⟩a; Ω := {⟨x,a⟩ > 0}; T_x := approxTangentPlane 2 M x, p_{T_x} its orthogonal projection; w(x) := |p_{T_x}(Ax)|, G(x) := w(x)²/|πx|², J(x) := w(x)/|πx|²; Z(s,s') := {x : ⟨x,a⟩ > 0, ||x| − 1| < s', |f(x)| < s', |q(x)| < s|x|}, Z := Z(s,s); F̃(x) := (|x|, f(x)); fibre X(p) := M ∩ Z ∩ F̃⁻¹{p}, H(p) := Σ_{x∈X(p)} θ(x)w(x), N(p) := Σ_{x∈X(p)} θ(x) (tsums in [0, ∞]). (F1) (a, e) is an orthonormal basis of Q, πx = ⟨x,a⟩a + ⟨x,e⟩e. (F2) A is linear with values in Q, ⟨Ax, x⟩ = 0, |Ax| = |πx|, so w ≤ |πx| ≤ |x|, πx ≠ 0 on Ω and 0 ≤ G ≤ 1 there. (F3) On Ω, f is C^∞, |f| < π/2, f(rx) = f(x) (r > 0), and πx = |πx|(cos f(x)·a + sin f(x)·e). (Supp) spt C = μ.support (`Submission.imrep_represents_support_eq_inter_measure_support`, U = univ) and μ((spt C)ᶜ) = 0 (`MeasureTheory.Measure.support_mem_ae`; ℝ^P is second countable). (Uniq) HasMassDensity C a θ and HasMassDensity C a θ' imply θ = θ'. 
0. (Inputs.) By the sibling `Submission.idtp_cse_edge_tangent_plane` (same hypotheses) there are m' ≥ 1 with HasMassDensity C a m' and the blow-up property (BP): for every sequence s'_j > 0, s'_j → 0, there are a subsequence (not relabelled), C' and c ∈ ℤ with |c| = m' such that C_j := blowUp C a s'_j ⇀ C', C'(ω) = c∫_Q ω(x)(a, e) dH²(x), and (V) s'_j^{−2}∫ g(η_j(x)) dμ(x) → m'∫_Q g dH² for every continuous compactly supported g, where η_j := dilation a s'_j (η_j(x) = (x − a)/s'_j). By (Uniq), m' = m. By the sibling `Submission.idtp_cse_cone_stationary_radial`, p_{T_x}x = x for μ-a.e. x. μ is finite on compact sets. In the following 0 < s' ≤ s.
1. (Localization.) Every x ∈ spt C ∩ Z(s, s') satisfies |q(x)| < (s'/4)|x| and |x − a| < 3s' (Loc(s), as |q(x)| < s|x| ≤ 2s|x|). By (Supp), μ(Z(s, s') ∖ B_{3s'}(a)) = 0.
2. (Rescaled boxes.) Put η := dilation a s' and D(s') := {w ∈ B_3(0) : a + s'w ∈ Z(s, s')} = η(Z(s, s') ∩ B_{3s'}(a)); by step 1, μ(Z(s, s')) = μ(η⁻¹(D(s'))). For |w| < 3 and 0 < s' ≤ 1/20, x := a + s'w satisfies ⟨x, a⟩ = 1 + s'⟨w, a⟩ ≥ 1 − 3s' > 0, ||x| − 1 − s'⟨w, a⟩| ≤ 30s'² (|x|² = 1 + y with y := 2s'⟨w,a⟩ + s'²|w|², |y| ≤ 1/2, |√(1 + y) − 1 − y/2| ≤ y²/2), |f(x) − s'⟨w, e⟩| ≤ 30s'² (f(x) = arctan(s'⟨w,e⟩/(1 + s'⟨w,a⟩)) and |arctan z − z| ≤ |z|³/3), and q(x) = s'q(w), so |q(x)| ≤ 3s' < s|x| when s' < s/6. Let η' ∈ (0, 1/2), U_{η'} := {w ∈ B_3(0) : |⟨w,a⟩| < 1 − η', |⟨w,e⟩| < 1 − η'} (open) and K_{η'} := {w ∈ closedBall(0, 3) : |⟨w,a⟩| ≤ 1 + η', |⟨w,e⟩| ≤ 1 + η'} (compact). If 0 < s' < min(1/20, η'/30, s/6) then U_{η'} ⊆ D(s') ⊆ K_{η'}: for w ∈ U_{η'}, ||x| − 1| ≤ s'(1 − η') + 30s'² < s', |f(x)| < s' likewise, |q(x)| < s|x| and |x − a| = s'|w| < 3s'; for w ∈ D(s'), s'|⟨w,a⟩| < s' + 30s'², i.e. |⟨w,a⟩| < 1 + 30s' < 1 + η', and likewise |⟨w,e⟩| < 1 + η'.
3. (Squares in Q.) ι(σ, u) := σa + ue is a linear isometry of Euclid 2 onto Q, so H²⌞Q is the image of Lebesgue measure (`Isometry.euclideanHausdorffMeasure_image`, `EuclideanSpace.euclideanHausdorffMeasure_eq_volume`). As ⟨ι(σ,u), a⟩ = σ, ⟨ι(σ,u), e⟩ = u and √2(1 + η') < 3, Q ∩ U_{η'} = ι((−(1−η'), 1−η')²) and Q ∩ K_{η'} = ι([−(1+η'), 1+η']²); so H²(Q ∩ U_{η'}) = 4(1 − η')² and H²(Q ∩ K_{η'}) = 4(1 + η')².
4. (Semicontinuity.) Along a subsequence where (V) holds: for an open U, liminf_j s'_j^{−2}μ(η_j⁻¹(U)) ≥ m H²(Q ∩ U) (for compact L ⊆ U and g(z) := max(0, 1 − dist(z, L)/ε) with ε < dist(L, Uᶜ), 1_L ≤ g ≤ 1_U, so s'_j^{−2}μ(η_j⁻¹U) ≥ s'_j^{−2}∫ g∘η_j dμ → m∫_Q g dH² ≥ m H²(Q ∩ L); take the supremum over compact L ⊆ U, using inner regularity of the locally finite measure H²⌞Q); for a compact K, limsup_j s'_j^{−2}μ(η_j⁻¹(K)) ≤ m H²(Q ∩ K) (use g_ε(z) := max(0, 1 − dist(z, K)/ε), 1_K ≤ g_ε ≤ 1_{K_ε} with K_ε the closed ε-neighbourhood, and H²(Q ∩ K_ε) ↓ H²(Q ∩ K) as ε ↓ 0).
5. (Mass limit.) Let s'_j → 0⁺ and pass to a subsequence where (V) holds. For each η' ∈ (0, 1/2) and large j, η_j⁻¹(U_{η'}) ⊆ η_j⁻¹(D(s'_j)) ⊆ Z(s, s'_j) and μ(Z(s, s'_j)) = μ(η_j⁻¹(D(s'_j))) ≤ μ(η_j⁻¹(K_{η'})) (step 2). By steps 3–4, 4m(1 − η')² ≤ liminf_j s'_j^{−2}μ(Z(s, s'_j)) ≤ limsup_j ≤ 4m(1 + η')². Letting η' → 0, s'_j^{−2}μ(Z(s, s'_j)) → 4m along the subsequence. Since every sequence s'_j → 0⁺ has a subsequence with this limit, μ(Z(s, s'))/ofReal(s'²) → 4m as s' → 0⁺ (the filter 𝓝[>]0 is countably generated).
6. (Orientation and tilt function.) Let β ∈ Covector(ℝ^P, 2) be the constant 2-covector β(v_0, v_1) := ⟨a,v_0⟩⟨e,v_1⟩ − ⟨a,v_1⟩⟨e,v_0⟩ (the determinant of the 2×2 matrix (⟨a,v_j⟩; ⟨e,v_j⟩), a continuous alternating map), and d(x) := ξ(x)(β). For μ-a.e. x (by `orients`, transferred from H²⌞M to μ ≪ H²⌞M, together with radial tangency): x ∈ M, T_x is 2-dimensional, ξ(x) = ±(α ↦ α(u_0, u_1)) for an orthonormal basis (u_0, u_1) of T_x (IsUnitOrientationOf, T_x being the unique approximate tangent space), and x ∈ T_x. For such x: |d(x)| = |β(u_0,u_1)| ≤ 1 (Cauchy–Schwarz and Bessel: |β(u_0,u_1)|² ≤ (⟨a,u_0⟩² + ⟨a,u_1⟩²)(⟨e,u_0⟩² + ⟨e,u_1⟩²) ≤ 1). If moreover x ∈ Ω, let x̂ := x/|x| ∈ T_x and τ ∈ T_x a unit vector ⊥ x̂; (x̂, τ) is an orthonormal basis of T_x, and β restricted to T_x is a multiple of the determinant in either basis, so β(u_0, u_1) = ±β(x̂, τ) and |d(x)| = |β(x̂, τ)|. Now ⟨τ, Ax⟩ = ⟨x,a⟩⟨τ,e⟩ − ⟨x,e⟩⟨τ,a⟩ = |x|·β(x̂, τ) and p_{T_x}(Ax) = ⟨x̂,Ax⟩x̂ + ⟨τ,Ax⟩τ = ⟨τ,Ax⟩τ, so w(x) = |x||d(x)| and G(x) = |x|²d(x)²/|πx|² ≥ d(x)². Hence 1 − G(x) ≤ 1 − d(x)² = (1 − |d(x)|)(1 + |d(x)|) ≤ 2(1 − |d(x)|).
7. (Tilt decay.) Claim: s'^{−2}∫_{B_{3s'}(a)} (1 − |d|) dμ → 0 as s' → 0⁺ (the integrand is in [0, 1] μ-a.e. by step 6). Let s'_j → 0⁺ and take a subsequence as in (BP). Fix ϑ ∈ C^∞(ℝ^P) with compact support, 0 ≤ ϑ ≤ 1 and ϑ = 1 on closedBall(0, 3) (a smooth bump), and let ω_ϑ(x) := ϑ(x)·β ∈ 𝒟²(ℝ^P). (a) The domain of C_j is η_j(ℝ^P) = dilation a s'_j '' univ = ℝ^P (η_j is a bijection), so currentEval(C_j, ω_ϑ) = C_j(ω_ϑ) (the test-form condition tsupport ω_ϑ ⊆ η_j(ℝ^P) holds), and ConvergesWeakly gives C_j(ω_ϑ) → C'(ω_ϑ) = c∫_Q ϑ(x)β(a, e) dH² = c∫_Q ϑ dH² (β(a, e) = |a|²|e|² − ⟨a,e⟩² = 1). (b) By `Submission.dtc_blowUp_testForm_corr` (U := univ, x := a, scale s'_j), the test form ω' with ω'(y) = ω_ϑ(η_j(y)) = ϑ(η_j y)·β satisfies C_j(ω_ϑ) = s'_j^{−2}C(ω'), and since R represents C, C(ω') = ∫_M θ(y)ξ(y)(ϑ(η_j y)β) dH²(y) = ∫ ϑ(η_j y)·d(y) dμ(y) (ξ(y) is linear). Hence |C_j(ω_ϑ)| ≤ s'_j^{−2}∫ ϑ∘η_j·|d| dμ. (c) By (V) with g := ϑ, s'_j^{−2}∫ ϑ∘η_j dμ → m∫_Q ϑ dH². (d) Therefore 0 ≤ s'_j^{−2}∫ ϑ∘η_j·(1 − |d|) dμ ≤ s'_j^{−2}∫ ϑ∘η_j dμ − |C_j(ω_ϑ)| → m∫_Q ϑ dH² − |c|∫_Q ϑ dH² = 0. For y ∈ B_{3s'_j}(a), η_j(y) ∈ B_3(0) and ϑ(η_j y) = 1; so s'_j^{−2}∫_{B_{3s'_j}(a)} (1 − |d|) dμ → 0 along the subsequence. As every sequence has such a subsequence, the claim follows.
8. (Flux limit.) G ≤ 1 on Ω ⊇ Z(s, s'), so ∫_{Z(s,s')} G dμ ≤ μ(Z(s, s')) < ∞. By steps 6 and 1, ∫_{Z(s,s')} G dμ ≥ μ(Z(s, s')) − 2∫_{Z(s,s')} (1 − |d|) dμ ≥ μ(Z(s, s')) − 2∫_{B_{3s'}(a)} (1 − |d|) dμ. Dividing by s'² and using step 5 and step 7, (∫_{Z(s,s')} G dμ)/ofReal(s'²) → 4m as s' → 0⁺. ∎
proof_key_steps: Sibling edge_tangent_plane: along subsequences of any s'_j → 0, C_j ⇀ ±m[[Q]] (orientation (a, e)) and s'_j^{-2}∫ g∘η_j dμ → m∫_Q g dH².
Loc(s) puts μ-almost all of Z(s, s') inside B_{3s'}(a); rescaled, Z(s, s') is squeezed between the squares U_{η'} and K_{η'} of Q-side 2(1 ∓ η').
Vague semicontinuity and H²(squares) = 4(1 ∓ η')² give μ(Z(s, s'))/s'² → 4m.
With d(x) = ξ(x)(a♭∧e♭), radial tangency gives 1 − G ≤ 2(1 − |d|) μ-a.e.
Testing C_j against ϑ·(a♭∧e♭) (dtc_blowUp_testForm_corr) shows s'^{-2}∫_{B_{3s'}(a)}(1 − |d|) dμ → 0, hence (∫_{Z(s,s')} G dμ)/s'² → 4m.

audit.reason: The proof establishes both exact normalized limits. Localization and rescaled-square bounds give the mass limit; weak-current testing gives tilt decay and hence the flux limit, without relying on flux_density.
